stories.title: Winning Powerball numbers for the $31 million jackpot on Nov. 25, 2026: See all the prizes hit in Ohio
stories.summary: Since nobody won the jackpot, the total now climbs to $48 million for the next drawing.

stories.title: Chloe Oliver scores 17, Cleveland State holds off Lindenwood 62-54
stories.summary: Led by Chloe Oliver's 17 points and eight rebounds, Cleveland State held off Lindenwood 62-54 Wednesday night at Woodling Gym.

stories.title: MAC says would-be winning TD for Kent State vs. Eastern Michigan was incorrectly overturned
stories.summary: Kent State receiver Wayne Harris had his game-winning touchdown against Eastern Michigan overturned. However, the MAC now says the play should've been upheld.

stories.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed for first time due to dangerous winds, impacting Ohioans statewide
stories.summary: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade's 100th anniversary will now take place Saturday after dangerous winds forced organizers to change plans.

stories.title: 71-year-old man dies after being struck by ODOT truck Monday on I-480 exit ramp
stories.summary: A man reportedly 'stepped directly into' the path of an ODOT truck that was exiting I-480 westbound. The 71-year-old was pronounced dead at a local hospital.

stories.title: Cleveland civic leader Orlando Grant to join Divine Nine performance for Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade centennial, despite postponement
stories.summary: Cleveland's Orlando Grant will be part of the first-ever Divine Nine Unity Step at the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

stories.title: Weather Impact Alert: Potential for soaked Thanksgiving Day in Northeast Ohio
stories.summary: Heavy rain could slow your travel on Thursday.

stories.title: Woman dies after being ejected from car that crashed on Ohio Turnpike in Cuyahoga County; man extricated, hospitalized
stories.summary: The crash occurred near the 156 milepost on Wednesday. The vehicle reportedly drove off the side of the road before striking a guardrail.

stories.title: At least 1 dead following multi-car crash on I-90 West in Cleveland
stories.summary: At least one person is dead following a multi-car crash on I-90 West in Cleveland's North Collinwood neighborhood.

stories.title: New York Knicks blow by Cleveland Cavaliers in 4th quarter, win 121-102 for 6th straight victory
stories.summary: Jose Alvarado scored a season-high 21 points, Mikal Bridges had a season-best 19 and the Knicks rode a blitz by their bench to a 121-102 victory over the Cavaliers.

stories.title: Rayvon Griffith scores 20 as Cleveland State beats Case Western Reserve 76-46
stories.summary: Rayvon Griffith’s 20 points helped Cleveland State defeat Case Western Reserve 76-46. Griffith finished 10 of 17 from the field for the Vikings.

stories.title: Thanksgiving travelers receive warm welcome at Cleveland Hopkins Airport, Ohio Turnpike
stories.summary: Destination Cleveland and the Ohio Turnpike welcomed holiday travelers Wednesday while officials encouraged motorists to prioritize safety during the busy holiday.
